title: TipsAudit Public Track Record — football predictions, fair odds and closing-line value
description: Daily, immutable snapshots of every football (soccer) 1X2 prediction published by TipsAudit, logged before kick-off with the sharp-market opening price, the devigged fair probability, the best soft-bookmaker price, the closing price, the closing-line value and the settled result; daily bookmaker-margin measurements across ~35 bookmakers; and the frozen specifications of pre-registered forward experiments. Every snapshot is SHA-256 listed in manifest.csv and anchored via OpenTimestamps.
